name: jpa/email-top-row
title: Email highlights
description: Headline open and click totals for a single email, split into Opens and Clicks views.

help.content: Headline stats for a single email. The Opens view shows total sends, unique opens, total opens, and open rate; the Clicks view shows total sends, unique opens, total clicks, and click rate. Rates are measured against total sends. Figures are all-time and are not affected by the dashboard date range.
